paper_metadata.title: Novel as-cast Ti-rich refractory complex concentrated alloys with superior tensile properties

process_steps.input_state: high-purity metals (≥99.9 wt%) of Ti, Zr, Nb, V, Mo, Al

evidence.quote: The Ti 3Zr1.5Nb(1−x)MoxVAl0.25 (x = 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, denoted as Mo0.1, Mo0.3, Mo0.5, respectively) RCCA ingots were fabricated by vacuum arc-melting technology by using the high-purity metals (≥99.9 wt%) of Ti, Zr, Nb, V, Mo, Al. A non-consumable vacuum arc melting furnace with high-purity argon gas protection and a tungsten electrode was used to melt and remelt the metals six times to ensure chemical homogeneity. Each alloy ingot with a mass of about 80 g was then drop-cast into a copper mold to form plates with dimensions of 12 mm (width) × 60 mm (length) × 5.7 mm (thickness).
